events.label: Наука
entries: 1996 – As part of the Great Internet Mersenne Prime Search (GIMPS) project, Joel Armengaud discovers the project's first Mersenne prime number, 2 1398269 − 1 {\displaystyle 2^{1398269}-1} , a number with 420,921 digits.

events.label: Искусство
entries: 1940 – Walt Disney's animated musical film Fantasia is first released at New York's Broadway Theatre, on the first night of a roadshow.
1945 – FC Dynamo Moscow open their exhibition tour of the United Kingdom with a 3–3 draw against Chelsea, breaking the record attendance for a British club football match.

events.label: Образование
entries: 1922 – The United States Supreme Court upholds mandatory vaccinations for public school students in Zucht v. King.
2022 – A mass stabbing occurs in Moscow, Idaho in which four University of Idaho students are killed in off-campus housing.
